# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-config-docs.js from the config schema. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every key is optional. Unknown keys are kept as they are. A `*` in a key stands for any name
(for example `roles.*.model` covers `roles.worker.model`, `roles.docs-writer.model`, ...).
The board's Settings page edits the same files and validates against the same schema.

## Project config: `<repo>/.claude/crew.json`

Committed with the project. Created by `crew init`.

| Key | Type and limits | Default | Description | 說明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer; one of `1` | `1` | Config format version. | 設定檔格式版本。 |
| `language` | string; one of `en`, `zh-TW` | `"en"` | Language of CLI output and generated files. | CLI 輸出與產生檔案的語言。 |
| `roles` | object | `{"orchestrator":{"engine":"claude","model":"inherit"},"worker":{"engine":"claude","model":"sonnet","agent":"crew-worker"},"reviewer":{"engine":"claude","model":"sonnet","agent":"crew-reviewer"},"refuter":{"engine":"claude","model":"sonnet","agent":"crew-refuter"}}` | Role map; add your own roles next to the built-in ones. | 角色對照表；可在內建角色之外自行新增。 |
| `roles.*` | object |  | One role. | 單一角色。 |
| `roles.*.engine` | string |  | "claude" or the name of an engine defined in the global config (engines are never read from this file). | "claude" 或全域設定中定義的引擎名稱（引擎定義不會從此檔讀取）。 |
| `roles.*.model` | string |  | inherit, opus, sonnet, haiku or a full model id. | inherit、opus、sonnet、haiku 或完整模型 ID。 |
| `roles.*.agent` | string |  | Agent name used for this role. | 此角色使用的 agent 名稱。 |
| `gates` | object | `{"push":"ask","open_pr":"ask","merge":"ask","remote_hosts":"ask","large_task":"ask","install_or_download":"ask","enforce":"remind","require_user_turn":true}` | Approval gates. | 核准關卡。 |
| `gates.push` | string; one of `auto`, `ask`, `never` | `"ask"` | What to do before this action: auto (just do it), ask (ask the user in chat first) or never. | 執行此動作前的處理方式：auto（直接做）、ask（先在對話中問使用者）、never（禁止）。 |
| `gates.open_pr` | string; one of `auto`, `ask`, `never` | `"ask"` | What to do before this action: auto (just do it), ask (ask the user in chat first) or never. | 執行此動作前的處理方式：auto（直接做）、ask（先在對話中問使用者）、never（禁止）。 |
| `gates.merge` | string; one of `auto`, `ask`, `never` | `"ask"` | What to do before this action: auto (just do it), ask (ask the user in chat first) or never. | 執行此動作前的處理方式：auto（直接做）、ask（先在對話中問使用者）、never（禁止）。 |
| `gates.remote_hosts` | string; one of `auto`, `ask`, `never` | `"ask"` | What to do before this action: auto (just do it), ask (ask the user in chat first) or never. | 執行此動作前的處理方式：auto（直接做）、ask（先在對話中問使用者）、never（禁止）。 |
| `gates.large_task` | string; one of `auto`, `ask`, `never` | `"ask"` | What to do before this action: auto (just do it), ask (ask the user in chat first) or never. | 執行此動作前的處理方式：auto（直接做）、ask（先在對話中問使用者）、never（禁止）。 |
| `gates.install_or_download` | string; one of `auto`, `ask`, `never` | `"ask"` | What to do before this action: auto (just do it), ask (ask the user in chat first) or never. | 執行此動作前的處理方式：auto（直接做）、ask（先在對話中問使用者）、never（禁止）。 |
| `gates.enforce` | string; one of `remind`, `confirm`, `block` | `"remind"` | When a push, PR or merge under an "ask" gate is checked: remind (after the command, reminder only), confirm (before it, Claude Code asks you to allow it) or block (before it, the command is denied until an approval is recorded). | 「ask」關卡的推送、PR、合併何時檢查：remind（執行後提醒）、confirm（執行前由 Claude Code 詢問你是否允許）、block（執行前拒絕，直到記錄核准）。 |
| `gates.require_user_turn` | boolean | `true` | An approval counts only when you sent a message between "gate ask" and "gate answer yes", so the model cannot approve itself within one turn. | 核准要在「gate ask」與「gate answer yes」之間有使用者送出訊息才算數，避免模型在同一輪自己核准。 |
| `limits` | object | `{"max_parallel_workers":3,"max_returns_before_takeover":2,"report_max_tokens":1500,"orchestrator_read_warn_lines":300,"orchestrator_edit":"warn","orchestrator_edit_allow":["**/*.md","docs/**",".claude/**",".crew/**"]}` | Limits and guards. | 限制與守門。 |
| `limits.max_parallel_workers` | integer; min 1; max 20 | `3` | Most workers running at once. | 同時進行的 worker 上限。 |
| `limits.max_returns_before_takeover` | integer; min 1; max 20 | `2` | Send-backs allowed before the orchestrator takes the task over. | 退回幾次後改由統籌接手。 |
| `limits.report_max_tokens` | integer; min 100; max 20000 | `1500` | Maximum worker report size (estimated as characters / 4). | worker 報告長度上限（以字元數 / 4 估算）。 |
| `limits.orchestrator_read_warn_lines` | integer; min 1; max 100000 | `300` | Warn when the orchestrator reads a file longer than this without a range. | 統籌不帶範圍讀超過此行數的檔案時提醒。 |
| `limits.orchestrator_edit` | string; one of `off`, `warn`, `block` | `"warn"` | What happens when the orchestrator edits code itself. | 統籌自己改程式時的處理。 |
| `limits.orchestrator_edit_allow` | array of string | `["**/*.md","docs/**",".claude/**",".crew/**"]` | Globs the orchestrator may edit directly. | 統籌可直接修改的路徑 glob。 |
| `review` | object | `{"min_confidence":0.6,"report_inference":false,"nit_cap":5,"categories":["correctness","security-exploitable","data-loss","regression","spec-mismatch","test-gap","maintainability","nit"],"downgrade_to_nit":["theoretical-race","style"]}` | Review pipeline settings. | 審查流程設定。 |
| `review.min_confidence` | number; min 0; max 1 | `0.6` | Findings below this confidence are dropped. | 低於此信心的發現會被濾掉。 |
| `review.report_inference` | boolean | `false` | Keep findings that are only inference. | 保留只憑推論的發現。 |
| `review.nit_cap` | integer; min 0; max 100 | `5` | Most nit findings shown. | 最多顯示幾筆瑣碎意見。 |
| `review.categories` | array of string | `["correctness","security-exploitable","data-loss","regression","spec-mismatch","test-gap","maintainability","nit"]` | Allowed finding categories. | 允許的發現類別。 |
| `review.downgrade_to_nit` | array of string | `["theoretical-race","style"]` | Patterns downgraded to nit. | 自動降為瑣碎意見的型態。 |
| `checks` | array of string | `[]` | Commands a worker must run before reporting. | worker 回報前必須執行的指令。 |
| `forbidden` | object | `{"paths":[],"actions":[]}` | Boundaries rendered into the worker agent file. | 寫進 worker agent 檔的禁止事項。 |
| `forbidden.paths` | array of string | `[]` | Paths a worker must not touch. | worker 不可碰的路徑。 |
| `forbidden.actions` | array of string | `[]` | Actions a worker must not take. | worker 不可做的動作。 |
| `board` | object | `{"enabled":true,"port":8781}` | Local board. | 本機看板。 |
| `board.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Enable the board. | 啟用看板。 |
| `board.port` | integer; min 1024; max 65535 | `8781` | Board port on 127.0.0.1. | 看板在 127.0.0.1 的連接埠。 |
| `lessons` | object | `{"promote_after_days":3,"rules_cap":15,"rules_file":"CLAUDE.md"}` | Lessons and promoted rules. | 經驗與升格規則。 |
| `lessons.promote_after_days` | integer; min 1; max 365 | `3` | Distinct days a lesson key must be seen before it is suggested. | 同一經驗出現在幾個不同日子後才建議升格。 |
| `lessons.rules_cap` | integer; min 1; max 200 | `15` | Most promoted rules kept. | 升格規則數量上限。 |
| `lessons.rules_file` | string | `"CLAUDE.md"` | File that holds the promoted-rules block. Must be inside the project folder. | 存放升格規則區塊的檔案，必須位於專案資料夾內。 |

## Global config: `~/.crewgate/config.json`

Per user (override the folder with `CREWGATE_HOME`). Not part of any repository.

| Key | Type and limits | Default | Description | 說明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer; one of `1` | `1` | Config format version. | 設定檔格式版本。 |
| `language` | string; one of `en`, `zh-TW` | `"en"` | Default language. | 預設語言。 |
| `port` | integer; min 1024; max 65535 | `8781` | Default board port. | 看板預設連接埠。 |
| `usage_days` | integer; min 1; max 365 | `14` | Days shown on the Usage page. | 用量頁顯示的天數。 |
| `prices` | object | `{}` | Price per million tokens by model name. | 各模型每百萬 token 單價。 |
| `prices.*` | object |  | One model. | 單一模型。 |
| `prices.*.input` | number; min 0 |  | Input price. | 輸入單價。 |
| `prices.*.output` | number; min 0 |  | Output price. | 輸出單價。 |
| `prices.*.cache_write` | number; min 0 |  | Cache write price. | 快取寫入單價。 |
| `prices.*.cache_read` | number; min 0 |  | Cache read price. | 快取讀取單價。 |
| `engines` | object | `{"codex":{"command":"codex","args":["exec","-s","read-only","--skip-git-repo-check","-"]}}` | External review engines (for example a Codex CLI reviewer). Defined only here, never in a project: a project can only name an engine in roles.*.engine. | 外部審查引擎（例如 Codex CLI）。只能定義在這裡，專案設定無法定義；專案只能在 roles.*.engine 以名稱引用。 |
| `engines.*` | object |  | One engine. | 單一引擎。 |
| `engines.*.command` | string |  | Executable to run (resolved through PATH; on Windows .cmd and .bat files work too). | 要執行的程式（依 PATH 尋找；Windows 也支援 .cmd 與 .bat）。 |
| `engines.*.args` | array of string |  | Arguments; the prompt is passed on stdin. | 參數；提示內容由標準輸入傳入。 |
| `board` | object | `{"show_text":false,"session_idle_minutes":30,"session_done_hours":6,"detect_closed_transcripts":false}` | Board display options. | 看板顯示選項。 |
| `board.show_text` | boolean | `false` | Show short redacted snippets (last prompt, last reply, session title) and the target of the current tool call (file, command, pattern) in the Sessions list. | 在工作階段清單顯示簡短的已遮罩片段（最後提示、最後回覆、工作階段標題）與目前工具呼叫的目標（檔案、指令、模式）。 |
| `board.session_idle_minutes` | integer; min 1; max 1440 | `30` | Minutes without activity after which a Sessions entry shows as idle. | 工作階段超過這段分鐘數沒有動靜就顯示為閒置。 |
| `board.session_done_hours` | integer; min 1; max 720 | `6` | Hours without activity after which a Sessions entry shows as done. | 工作階段超過這段小時數沒有動靜就顯示為已結束。 |
| `board.detect_closed_transcripts` | boolean | `false` | Treat a transcript that ends in a closing record (last-prompt) as a finished session. Off by default: the record is not verified to mean the session ended, so a live session waiting for you could be shown as done. | 把結尾為關閉記錄（last-prompt）的逐字稿視為已結束的工作階段。預設關閉：該記錄是否代表工作階段結束尚未驗證，開啟後等待您回應的使用中工作階段可能被顯示為已結束。 |
| `updates` | object | `{"check":true}` | Update notices. | 更新通知。 |
| `updates.check` | boolean | `true` | Let the board ask GitHub (api.github.com, at most once a day, nothing about you or your projects is sent) whether a newer crewgate release exists and show a notice. Turn off to make no network request at all. | 讓看板向 GitHub（api.github.com，一天最多一次，不會送出任何關於您或專案的資料）查詢是否有較新的 crewgate 版本並顯示通知。關閉後完全不發出網路請求。 |
